raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Fixes #46631. Multimodal **image** inputs that work on `/v1/chat/completions` still fail on `/v1/responses`.

#57241 fixed the missing `detail` default. The chat-completions image shapes still fail validation:
- `"type": "image_url"` instead of `"input_image"`
- nested `image_url: {"url": X}` instead of the flat `image_url: X` string that `ResponseInputImageParam` expects

## Fix

Extend #57241's `BeforeValidator` (renamed `_normalize_input_images`) so it also maps `image_url` → `input_image` and flattens `{"url": X}` → `X`. Now the same image payload works on both endpoints.

## Test

```
pytest tests/tool_use/test_responses_request_validations.py tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_protocol.py   # 27 passed
```

- New `test_input_image_accepts_chat_completions_format` (both part types): fails on `main`, passes with this fix. CPU-only.
- e2e `test_single_chat_session_image_chat_completions_format` in `tests/entrypoints/multimodal/openai/responses/test_image.py` runs the same shapes through a live server.
- `ruff check` / `ruff format` clean.

> AI assistance was used to investigate and implement this change; the diff and tests were reviewed and run locally.

I have attempted to trace it to the best of my abilities. input_image is parsed in chat_utils.py (MM_PARSER_MAP["input_image"] → _ResponsesInputImageParser → mm_parser.parse_image). That parser is TypeAdapter(ResponseInputImageParam), and the type is a TypedDict with detail: Required and image_url: Optional[str] (flat string).

my understanding is that the chat-completions shape (nested image_url={"url": ...}, no detail) is rejected at ResponsesRequest validation, before chat_utils runs (_ResponsesInputImageParser rejects it too). That's why the normalization has to sit at the request-validation layer rather than in the image parser. 

to make  image normalization more clear,  I pulled it out into a named _normalize_chat_completions_image_parts helper  so the intent is explicit.

@@ -113,6 +113,44 @@ async def test_single_chat_session_image_base64encoded(
     assert len(response.output_text) > 0
 
 
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("model_name", [MODEL_NAME])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("part_type", ["input_image", "image_url"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("raw_image_url", TEST_IMAGE_ASSETS)
+async def test_single_chat_session_image_chat_completions_format(
+    client: openai.AsyncOpenAI,
+    model_name: str,
+    part_type: str,
+    raw_image_url: str,
+    url_encoded_image: dict[str, str],
+):
+    # #46631: accept chat-completions image shapes (image_url type or
+    # input_image with nested image_url, no detail)
+    content_text = "What's in this image?"
+    messages = [
+        {
+            "role": "user",
+            "content": [
+                {
+                    "type": part_type,
+                    "image_url": {"url": url_encoded_image[raw_image_url]},
+                },
+                {"type": "input_text", "text": content_text},
+            ],
+        }
+    ]
+    response = await client.responses.create(
+        model=model_name,
+        input=messages,
+    )
+    assert response.status == "completed"
+    assert len(response.output) >= 1
+    message = next((out for out in response.output if out.type == "message"), None)
+    assert message is not None
+    assert message.role == "assistant"
+    assert len(response.output_text) > 0
+

 ResponseInputOutputItem: TypeAlias = ResponseInputItemParam | ResponseOutputItem
